title: Precession Rate of a Gyroscope
body: A gyroscope has a $$0.5$$ kg disk $$(I=(1/2)mr**{2})$$ that spins at $$40\, \tfrac{\text{rev}}{\text{s}}$$. $$The$$ $$center$$ $$of$$ $$mass$$ $$of$$ $$the$$ $$disk$$ $$is$$ $$15\, \text{cm}$$ from a pivot. The radius of the disk is $$10\, \text{cm}$$. $$ \cup se$$ $$g=9.8\,\tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}**2}$$.
